xml_defects.note: two distinct, separately-repairable defects; an earlier manifest entry conflated them and wrongly called 11 of 18 exports unusable
xml_defects.encoding: raw tag bytes (notably FF FF FF FF for a NONE tag reference) are written into attribute values under an <?xml version="1.0"?> declaration naming no encoding, so the file is invalid UTF-8. Affected 11 of 18. This is why a byte-reading parser (XmlDocument.Load) rejected all 11 while a string parser accepted 8 - an encoding artefact, not malformed markup.
xml_defects.unescaped_ampersands: authored string content is written into attribute values unescaped, e.g. value="a&&b". Genuinely malformed markup. Affected exactly 3 of 18: scoreboard.cui_logic (2), base_hud.cui_screen (2), mc_hud.cui_screen (4).
xml_defects.resolution: tools/export_h4_kit.ps1 declares iso-8859-1 and escapes only ampersands not already opening a valid entity; all 18 exports now parse with zero quarantined. Repairs are reported and the pristine tool.exe bytes are preserved as .xml.orig - never a silent rewrite.
